newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banque Audi rallies in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banque Audi rallies in Beirut.

text.p: Banque Audi shares continued a price rally on the Beirut stock exchange on Monday, trading at $19.125 from $19.
The shares have performed strongly since they began trading on the BSE at $15 on January 20.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the other bank listed on the market, fell to $13.5 from $13.625 on Friday.
Turnover in Audi shares was 21,020 shares against Friday's 25,000 and 5,686 BLC shares were traded from 12,500.
The LIBX bank index fell 0.13 percent to 117.94.
Solidere shares were steady. A shares traded at $10.25 and B shares were unchanged at $10.75. A total of 231,246 Solidere shares were traded against Friday's 207,342.
Also traded were some 500 Eternit shares at $1.75, up from $1.6875 on March 13 when they were last traded.
Total BSE turnover was 258,452 shares for a value of $2,877,701 against 254,298 shares for a value of $2,930,068.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais shares and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.04 percent to 901.88 and the LISPI rose 0.34 percent to 83.61.
